insurer_name: Royal Sundaram General Insurance Co. Limited
specific_diseases_listed: Stones in biliary and urinary systems
Sinusitis/Deviated Nasal Septum/Tympanoplasty/Chronic Suppurative Otitis Media
sub_limits_waiting_notes: PED Coverage in years 2 & 3: 50% co-pay up to Rs.2 lakhs (inpatient only). Not available for 16 specified illnesses.

inpatient_hospitalization.limit_text: Indemnity up to Sum Insured. Modern Treatments up to SI.
inpatient_hospitalization.notes: 4X Multiplier Benefit in Life Threatening Conditions provides additional 4 times SI+NCB.

ambulance_cover.limit_text: Emergency Ambulance + app-based cabs up to Rs.5,000 per hospitalization

critical_illness_cover.limit_text: Second Opinion for 22 critical illnesses; 4X Multiplier Benefit (4 times SI in Life Threatening Conditions, available 4 times in policy lifetime across family)

restoration_benefit.limit_text: Flexi Reload of Sum Insured up to 100% of Base SI
restoration_benefit.notes: Once per policy year, from 2nd claim onwards. Available for same illness same insured. Floater Reload available on floater basis.

copayment_trigger_notes: Voluntary Co-payment options 5%/10%/15%/20% (optional with premium discount). 50% co-pay for PED in years 2-3 up to Rs.2L.

worldwide_emergency_cover.notes: Emergency Domestic Evacuation up to Rs.1 lakh covered.

temporary_exclusions: 36 months PED (with PED rider covering 50% co-pay in years 2-3)
notable_exclusions_summary: Multiplier excludes maternity, infertility, OPD, refractive error, and treatments outside India. The signature 4X Multiplier Benefit provides up to 11X Sum Insured (Base + NCB + 4X) in Life Threatening Conditions, available 4 times in policy lifetime.
claim_process_summary: Cashless through TPA at network hospitals; reimbursement via document submission. Settled within 15 days of last document. Penal interest 2% above bank rate for delay.
available_riders: Health & Wellness Plus (Endorsement 1) - app, teleconsult, virtual coach
ABCD Benefit (Endorsement 2) - PED cover for Asthma/BP/Cholesterol/Diabetes
Hospital Plus (Endorsement 3) - consumables + mobility devices up to Rs.50,000
